name: shell
title: Shell
description: Shell, an application's whole frame from its routes: a skip link, a Topbar (sidebar trigger, brand, ⌘K search, actions), a grouped Sidebar that sticks under it, collapses (remembered) and is a drawer on narrow screens, a command palette whose Go to group reaches every route, a MobileNav bottom bar with More on narrow screens, and the main landmark. Router-agnostic: onNavigate for a history router, #/route hrefs for a hash router, or plain fast links.
docs: `<Shell routes={routes} groups={[{ id: "main", label: "Workspace" }, { id: "legacy", label: "Legacy", tone: "muted" }]} currentHref={pathname} onNavigate={(href) => router.push(href)} brand={<Logo />} actions={<UserMenu />} storageKey="app-sidebar">{page}</Shell>`, with `routes` of `{ id, label, href, icon?, group?, mobile?, placements?, keywords?, badge? }` (extend the type with your own fields: `onNavigate` gets your route back). `currentHref` is an href or a matcher `(href) => pathname.startsWith(href)` (the longest match wins); it sets `aria-current="page"` and the primary fill in the sidebar, the bottom bar and the palette. Without `onNavigate` routes are plain links that fast links follow on press, and `#/route` hrefs work with a hash router. Routes flagged `mobile: true` (up to four) fill the bottom bar on narrow screens and More opens the rest; `mobile: { order: 1 }` orders the bar apart from the sidebar (by `order`, then list position; `true` is order 0); `placements` (`"sidebar"`, `"mobile"`, `"more"`, `"palette"`, all by default) limits where a route shows, and decides over `mobile`: without `"mobile"` it stays out of the bar, and listing it puts the route in the bar; the bar is sticky at the end of the shell, so the page always ends above it. Translate every string with `labels` (`skipToContent`, `sidebar`, `mobileNav`, `goTo`, `more`, `openSearch`, `search`, `empty`…). Add palette commands with `commandGroups` (CommandGroups) and run them with `onCommand`. `searchFooter` goes at the bottom of the palette, for key hints in your language. The palette's Go to commands are links to the routes' hrefs (Ctrl/Cmd+click opens a new tab); following one closes the palette and goes through `onNavigate`. Each open of the palette starts with an empty search and one Escape closes it; `searchQuery`/`onSearchQueryChange` control the search and `defaultSearchQuery` starts each open. `sidebarShortcut="mod+b"` (opt-in) toggles the sidebar, or opens its drawer on narrow screens. `useShellSidebar()` inside the Shell returns its `useSidebarState()` result (`collapsed`, `setCollapsed`, `controller`); to hold it outside, call `useSidebarState({ storageKey })` yourself and pass it as `sidebar`. `sidebarHeader` and `sidebarFooter` go above and below the sidebar's routes. `main="fill"` (or a route's `main: "fill"` while it is current) gives `<main>` the height left under the topbar and above the bottom bar, so a `DocumentWorkspace` or any `h-full` page fills it and scrolls inside; no wrapper sized with `--shell-column-height`. Put pages in `PageLayout` (not `as="main"`: the shell owns `<main id="main">`). Inside a pane, set `--shell-height` in `style` to the pane's height and pass `as="div"` if the page already has its `<main>`.
